ALIGN.do: Give independently made parts one shared reference and align them to it; stop when they read as one.

ALTERNATE.def: Switch between two states on a fixed pattern; neither is final
ALTERNATE.do: Switch between two on a fixed pattern; neither is the end.

ATTEND.do: Watch with no goal and collect nothing; the first note or insight you take ends it.

BUILD ON THE MARKS.def: Coordinate through traces left in the environment rather than direct communication
BUILD ON THE MARKS.do: The trace decides where the next act goes.

CALIBRATE.def: Check against original intention, correct drift
CALIBRATE.do: Check the work against the stated intention at fixed points, never against today's taste; correct only the drift.

CLASSIFY.def: Sort instances until the system appears
CLASSIFY.do: Sort until the sorting rule appears.

CONCEAL.def: Withhold something from view so its absence operates
CONCEAL.do: Withhold it where everyone can see it is withheld; the cover never comes off.

CONSTRAIN.def: Make one category of decision impossible
CONSTRAIN.do: Ban one whole category of choices; work inside what's left.

CONTAIN.def: Put one whole thing inside another and keep both edges
CONTAIN.do: Put one whole inside another; keep both edges; the inner one comes out whole.

COUPLE.def: Tie two things so that a change in one moves the other
COUPLE.do: Tie the two; change one; let the other move only through the tie.
COUPLE.obj: structure of the artefact; material in hand

DEFER.do: Hand the decision over and obey the answer; no taking it back, even when you dislike it.

DEGRADE.do: Reduce step by step until it stops working; the failure point is the finding.

DELEGATE.do: Keep only the frame and hand every decision inside it to the group; never override what comes back.

DEPRIVE.do: Remove the whole channel, not some of it; keep it gone until the other senses have reorganised.

DIFFER FROM EACH.def: Make a new thing that differs from each earlier one in a different respect
DIFFER FROM EACH.do: Depart from each earlier one in its own respect, one respect each.

DISPERSE.def: Spread the whole across excess incomplete parts so many subsets remain sufficient
DISPERSE.do: Cut into more pieces than needed so any two-thirds work; pull a third at random; if it breaks, spread it and try again.
DISPERSE.obj: structure of the artefact; social arrangement

DISSOLVE AND REBUILD.do: Break it down until no part survives intact, then rebuild from the residue alone.

DON'T REPEAT YET.def: Keep recent moves unavailable until enough different ones have been made
DON'T REPEAT YET.do: What you just did is off-limits, and comes back only after enough different moves.

ELICIT.do: Supply only the shape of the prompt, never the content; everything that appears must come from them.

END WHILE IT WORKS.def: Retire something deliberately, while it still works
END WHILE IT WORKS.do: Set the end while it still works and keep to it; never wait for it to fail.

EXAGGERATE.do: One feature, too big; still itself.
EXAGGERATE.obj: material in hand; structure of the artefact

EXCHANGE.def: Pass something between parties so the transfer becomes the event
EXCHANGE.do: Pass it between parties in both directions; stop when each side holds something that came from the other.

EXECUTE.def: Take up and continue what another began
EXECUTE.do: Continue what another began and keep every decision they made; no starting over.

EXHAUST.do: Record every instance, the dull ones too; stop only when none are left.

FEED BACK.def: Make the system respond to its own output
FEED BACK.do: Route the output back into the system and leave the loop closed until the system has acted on it.

FIND THE THRESHOLD.do: Vary one amount until it changes kind; cross the point from both sides and mark exactly where it is.

FOREGROUND.do: Work only on the incidental; no return to the official subject until the time you set is up.

GENERALISE.do: State the pattern as a rule an instance could break; stop when you can name the case that would break it.

GRAFT.do: Join them so they cannot be taken apart; stop when pulling would break something rather than separate it.
GRAFT.obj: material in hand; structure of the artefact

HALVE.def: Split the field in two, keep the half that holds it, and split again
HALVE.do: Cut in two; keep the half that holds it; cut again; stop at one.

HAND OVER.def: Transfer full ownership so it continues without you
HAND OVER.do: Give away the authority itself; after the handover, no advice, check-ins or quiet corrections.

ITERATE.do: Run the cycle again on its own output; don't stop at one.

JUXTAPOSE.do: Place them side by side with no caption; stop before you explain the pairing.

LAY OVER.def: Lay one thing over another on the same ground; keep each whole
LAY OVER.do: Lay each layer over the last; keep each whole; read the stack.

LEASE.def: Grant authority until a deadline; it lapses unless renewed
LEASE.do: Grant it with an end date; it lapses unless renewed.

LOCATE.do: Choose where it stands and be ready to defend the choice; nothing starts until "here" is decided.

MARK TIME.def: Make time's passage visible through accumulated evidence
MARK TIME.do: One mark per fixed interval; a missed interval stays missed, and no mark is ever made late.

MIMIC.def: Make one thing pass as another
MIMIC.do: Make it pass as something else.

MORPH.def: Start from a version that works; change it by small steps toward another form, keeping it working at every step
MORPH.do: Change one step at a time toward the chosen form; every step must work.

NAME.do: Find the exact word, not the near one; stop when you can say what the name leaves out.

OCCUPY.def: Claim a position and hold it, so presence becomes structural
OCCUPY.do: Take the position and stay, without explaining why; the first justification turns it into a request.

PARTITION.def: Divide continuous space into zones with different rules
PARTITION.do: Draw the line and give each side a different rule; if both sides keep the same rule, the line is decoration.

RAISE THE COST.def: Let use change the threshold for future use
RAISE THE COST.do: Each use raises the cost of the next; stop at the first skip and count the uses.

RANK.def: Put things in order of importance and show the order
RANK.do: Order by importance, no ties; show the order in size or place.

READ THE INTERFERENCE.def: Identify interference between two consistent systems
READ THE INTERFERENCE.do: Overlay the two systems and read only the interference; blame neither.

REFRAME.def: Change the boundary, not the content
REFRAME.do: Move only the edge and leave the content alone; stop when every change you see traces back to the edge.

RELOCATE.def: Move something so its context changes its meaning
RELOCATE.do: Move it untouched and let the new surroundings do all the changing; any change to the thing itself voids it.

RITUALISE.def: Turn a single action into a structure that repeats
RITUALISE.do: Fix the form and the schedule, stated well enough to teach; repeat it exactly, every time.

RUN IT LONG.do: Sustain it until the length itself changes what it is.

SAMPLE.def: Lift a fragment into a new whole
SAMPLE.do: Build the new thing around the found piece.

SATURATE.def: Flood a sensory channel past its processing capacity
SATURATE.do: Flood one channel past capacity — and keep flooding.

SCAFFOLD.def: Put in a support only so the work can be made; take it out before the end
SCAFFOLD.do: Add a support only for the making; take it out before the end; the work stands or falls.
SCAFFOLD.obj: structure of the artefact; material in hand

STRIP.do: Remove one thing at a time; stop when the next removal would break it.
STRIP.obj: material in hand; structure of the artefact

SUBSTITUTE.def: Put B where A was; keep A's place, role and links
SUBSTITUTE.do: Swap the occupant by a stated rule; keep its place, role and links.

SUSPEND THE RULES.def: Create conditions where normal rules suspend
SUSPEND THE RULES.do: Mark an edge in and an edge out, and suspend the ordinary rules only between them; they return at the edge out.

TRACE.do: Follow the changes back link by link, on evidence only; stop where the evidence runs out, not where the story would.

TRANSLATE.def: Move material across media without adapting it
TRANSLATE.do: Carry it into the new medium without adapting it; keep every loss, and stop when the whole has crossed.

TRIANGULATE.do: Come at it three ways that share no source; keep only what all three agree on.
